# zgui-js

> Native Linux/Wayland desktop apps and Wayland shells written in TypeScript + SolidJS 2.0 + Lightning CSS Modules, rendered natively by Rust (`zgui`, Stylo, Taffy, Vello/Vulkan) and QuickJS-NG — no browser, no Chromium, no Electron, no DOM.

## Architecture & Constraints

- **Runtime**: QuickJS-NG (`rquickjs`) executes compiled ES2022 modules inside the Rust `zgui-host` process. There is no `window`, `document`, `fetch`, or WebView.
- **Reactivity & Compiler**: SolidJS 2.0 (`solid-js@2.0.1`) compiled with `@solidjs/compiler@2.0.1` (`generate: "universal"`, `moduleName: "@hewel/zgui/renderer"`) + Rolldown native TypeScript stripping.
- **Styling**: Plain CSS + Lightning CSS Modules (`*.module.css`). StyleX and Babel are removed. Never use `composes` or `dashedIdents` in CSS Modules. Always import `./*.module.css` as a default object and join classes with `cx()`.
- **Capabilities & Security**: All host I/O (files, Unix sockets, commands, HTTP/SSE/WS origins, clipboard, SQLite, workers, shell surfaces) is capability-gated in `package.json` under `zgui.capabilities` and sealed into `manifest.json` with SHA-256 `artifactDigests`.
- **Host-Owned Overlays & Preview**: Dev reload banners and visual inspector overlays are Rust-owned (`host-dev-*` stylesheets), never active outside dev mode, and strictly forbidden on `SessionLockSurface`.
- **Linux/Wayland DevShell**: On Nix-only hosts, enter `shell.nix` once per session so `pkg-config`, native libraries, and Mesa `VK_DRIVER_FILES` match; on standard Linux distros with native dev packages installed, run `cargo` and `bun` directly.

## CLI (`@hewel/zgui-cli` -> `zgui-js`)

Install `@hewel/zgui-cli` (or scaffold with `bun create zgui-js`). The binary name is `zgui-js` (never `zgui`).

- `zgui-js init [DIR] [--template desktop-app|wayland-shell] [--name NAME] [--force]` — Scaffold a new app.
- `zgui-js dev [DIR] [--dev-inspect PATH] [--strict-typecheck] [--pure-shell] [--width N] [--height N] [--title TEXT] [--exit-after-ms N]` — Build, watch (non-blocking `tsrs`, CSS-only hot-swap, dev state preservation), and run `zgui-host`.
- `zgui-js build [DIR] [--watch] [--bytecode] [--capabilities-file FILE]` — Type-check and emit an immutable, SHA-256 sealed `dist/` bundle (optional QuickJS `.qjsb` bytecode via `--bytecode`).
- `zgui-js typecheck [DIR] [--project FILE] [--include GLOB] [--types-only]` — Sync `*.module.css.d.ts` declarations and run `tsrs --noEmit`.
- `zgui-js preview [DIR] [--watch] [--profile F] [--fixture F] [--scenario F] [--out DIR]` — Headless Vulkan/Stylo offscreen capture & scenario assertions.
- `zgui-js package [DIR] --out DIR [--bytecode] [--desktop-entry] [--pure-shell]` — Assemble a self-contained runnable Linux app directory.
- `zgui-js doctor [--json] [--host-root DIR] [--host-executable PATH]` — Verify Bun, `zgui-host` ABI, Wayland, Vulkan, portal, `tsrs`, and `oxlint`.
- `zgui-js inspect [--ui] [--socket PATH] [--op tree|profile | pick]` — Query the `0600` `--dev-inspect` socket (`--op tree` / `--op profile`), toggle the native visual picker (`pick` or `Ctrl+Shift+I`), or open the self-hosted Inspector window (`--ui`).
- `zgui-js smoke` — Build the compiler/runtime smoke fixture.

## Core SDK (`@hewel/zgui`)

- **Mounting & Reactivity**: `renderApp`, `renderShell`, `flush`, `createSignal`, `createMemo`, `createEffect`, `onSettled`, `onCleanup`, `getOwner`, `runWithOwner`, `untrack`, `For`, `Repeat`, `Show`, `Switch`, `Match`, `Loading`, `Errored`, `createContext`, `useContext`, `omit`, `merge`, `createStore`, `createProjection`, `reconcile`, `snapshot`, `isPending`, `latest`, `refresh`, `action`
- **Intrinsic Native Elements**: `<box>`, `<row>`, `<column>`, `<stack>`, `<text>`, `<label>`, `<scroll>`, `<control>`, `<field>`, `<editor>`, `<image>`, `<vector>` (use `testId="..."` for preview selectors, `class={cx(...)}` for CSS Modules, `documentSelection?: boolean | null | undefined` paired with CSS `user-select: text` on the container for opt-in cross-block read-only `<text>` selection — see `tests/preview/document-selection.test.mjs`, `inert?: boolean | null | undefined` for native document-scoped subtree isolation from hit-testing/capture/focus/AT while layout, paint, CSS transitions, and `createSpring` keep running — bind `inert={!presence.present()}` rather than `!mounted()` on retained exits so reopening clears isolation immediately, scalar `ariaActiveDescendant?: NativeNode | null | undefined` for virtual focus relations without moving native focus, `NativeEvent.modifiers.{capsLock, numLock}: boolean` for queue-time lock-key state snapshots, and `NativeKeyEvent.isComposing: boolean` on `onKeyDown`/`onKeyUp` to guard keyboard shortcuts during IME preedit; capture-phase Escape dismiss automatically ignores composing Escape keys).
- **Shell Surfaces**: `LayerSurface`, `PopupSurface`, `SessionLockSurface`, `WindowSurface`, `getSessionGeneration`, `mountShellStylesheet`, `requestActivationToken`, `requestSessionLock`, `useMonitors` (`requestActivationToken` mints a single-use gesture-bound external `xdg_activation_v1` token from the active trusted press/key gesture via `options?: ActivationTokenOptions` (`{ readonly appId?: string }`), synchronously committing on the Wayland wire ahead of any same-turn surface close and resolving to `null` in headless preview, under retained session lock, outside a gesture, or after 500 ms without needing extra `zgui.capabilities`. `WindowSurface`, `LayerSurface`, and `PopupSurface` accept declarative `blurRegion?: BlurRegion` — `"none" | "full" | readonly NativeWindowRect[] | readonly NativeNode[] | BlurRegionNodes` where `BlurRegionNodes = { readonly nodes: readonly NativeNode[]; readonly minOpacity?: number }`. Wayland prefers `niri_blur_shape_v1` for wire-quantized rounded/superellipse masks and continuous effective opacity; `minOpacity` applies only to the binary `ext_background_effect_v1` fallback. Rust resolves node bounds, ancestor clips, and animations with the frame, without JS `observeGeometry`. `SessionLockSurface` excludes blur. Upgrade `@hewel/zgui` and `zgui-host` together; old hosts reject `{ nodes }` payloads even with unchanged `hostApiVersion: 1`. `PopupSurface` also accepts `geometryInsets?: SurfaceInsets` — nonnegative whole CSS px scalar or `{ top?, right?, bottom?, left? }` — reserving outer drawable bleed via `xdg_surface.set_window_geometry` while keeping `width`/`height`/`minHeight`/`maxHeight` visual.)
- **Window Management**: `beginWindowMoveDrag`, `closeWindow`, `getCapsLock`, `getWindowState`, `onCloseRequest`, `setWindowDecorations`, `setWindowFullscreen`, `setWindowMaximized`, `setWindowMinimized`, `setWindowTitle`, `useCapsLock`, `useWindowState` (`getCapsLock` reads a point-in-time boolean snapshot and `useCapsLock` observes per-mount-region Caps Lock state reactively for the current Solid owner, including `SessionLockSurface` focus replay.)
- **Core Components & Collections**: `Button`, `TextField`, `TextArea`, `Image`, `Portal`, `VirtualList`, `VirtualGrid`
- **Layout, Focus, Selection, Scroll & Canvas**: `focus`, `trapFocus`, `registerDismissLayer`, `lockScroll`, `scrollBy`, `scrollTo`, `scrollIntoView`, `getWindowRect`, `observeGeometry`, `precedes`, `getTextContent`, `getSelection`, `setSelection`, `selectAll`, `getDocumentSelection`, `setDocumentSelection`, `selectDocumentAll`, `clearDocumentSelection`, `createCanvasScene`, `mountStylesheet`, `isAnimating`, `getReducedMotion`, `setReducedMotion`, `getBackgroundBlurSupported`
- **Motion, Timers, Styling & Dev State**: `createSpring` (mount-only `initial`, reactive `settled`, `jump`, `impulse`, `configure`, shared per-bridge rAF ticker), `createDelay`, `createInterval`, `createTimeout`, `cx`, `createDevState`. Scroll containers default to `--zgui-scrollbar-mode: classic` and support inherited `--zgui-scrollbar-mode: overlay` (zero layout gutter, auto-hiding `4px`/`6px` floating capsule over a `12px` grab strip / `16px` edge hotzone, `800ms` hold + `200ms` fade, hidden click pass-through, `reduced_motion`-aware, reusing `--zgui-scrollbar-thumb`, `--zgui-scrollbar-track`, and `color-scheme`).
- **Drag & Drop**: `startInternalDrag`, `startOutboundDrag`

## Privileged Base Shell Host (`@hewel/zgui/shell-host`)

Excluded from the extension shared-runtime allowlist (`@hewel/zgui/shell-host` is base-shell exclusive):

- `SessionLockSurface`, `requestSessionLock`, `loadApprovedExtensionEntry`, `loadApprovedPluginEntry`, `listApprovedExtensionEntries`, `listApprovedPluginEntries`, `registerSessionHandoff`, `takeSessionHandoff`, `onSessionCommitted`, `onBeforeSessionCommit`, `getOverlayStatus`, `registerSharedRuntimeModules`

## UI Components (`@hewel/zgui/components`)

- **Theming & Icons**: `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, `themeTokens`, `Icon`
- **Actions & Layout**: `Button`, `ButtonGroup`, `ButtonGroupText`, `ButtonGroupSeparator`, `Badge`, `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`, `Separator`, `Kbd`, `KbdGroup`, `AspectRatio`, `SplitPane`, `SplitPanePanel`, `SplitPaneHandle`, `Item`, `ItemGroup`, `ItemSeparator`, `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent`, `ItemTitle`, `ItemDescription`, `ItemActions`, `ItemHeader`, `ItemFooter`
- **Forms & Inputs**: `Input`, `Textarea`, `Label`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Toggle`, `RadioGroup`, `RadioGroupItem`, `ToggleGroup`, `ToggleGroupItem`, `Slider`, `InputGroup`, `InputGroupAddon`, `InputGroupText`, `InputGroupButton`, `InputGroupInput`, `InputGroupTextarea`, `Select`, `Combobox`
- **Feedback & Status**: `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `Avatar`, `AvatarImage`, `AvatarFallback`, `AvatarBadge`, `AvatarGroup`, `AvatarGroupCount`, `Empty`, `EmptyHeader`, `EmptyMedia`, `EmptyTitle`, `EmptyDescription`, `EmptyContent`, `Progress`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `ToastProvider`, `useToast`, `toast`
- **Disclosure, Navigation & Overlays**: `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`, `Collapsible`, `CollapsibleTrigger`, `CollapsibleContent`, `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AccordionContent`, `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`, `DialogDismiss`, `Popover`, `PopoverTrigger`, `PopoverContent`, `PopoverHeader`, `PopoverTitle`, `PopoverDescription`, `PopoverClose`, `Popper`, `solvePopper`, `Tooltip`, `TooltipProvider`, `TooltipTrigger`, `TooltipContent`, `TooltipArrow`, `HoverCard`, `HoverCardTrigger`, `HoverCardContent`, `TreeView`, `TreeItem`, `CommandPalette`, `CommandPaletteProvider`, `useCommandPalette`, `scoreCommandMatch`
- **Menus**: `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `MenuContent`, `MenuTypeahead`, `MenuItem`, `MenuCheckboxItem`, `MenuRadioGroup`, `MenuRadioItem`, `MenuLabel`, `MenuGroup`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuShortcut`, `MenuSub`, `MenuSubTrigger`, `MenuSubContent`, `headingToward`, `ContextMenu`, `ContextMenuTrigger`, `ContextMenuContent`, `useContextMenuPlace`, `Menubar`, `MenubarMenu`, `MenubarTrigger`, `MenubarContent`, `MenubarArrows`, `MenubarItem`, `MenubarCheckboxItem`, `MenubarRadioItem`, `MenubarLabel`, `MenubarSeparator`, `MenubarShortcut`, `MenubarGroup`, `MenubarRadioGroup`

## Headless Primitives (`@hewel/zgui/primitives`)

Zero-stylesheet behavioral primitives decoupled from `Portal`, `Popper`, and built-in component stylesheets (work identically inside `WindowSurface`, `LayerSurface`, and `PopupSurface`):

- **Overlay, Presence, Focus & Delay**: `createPresence`, `createRetainedPresence`, `createOverlayState`, `createDismissLayer`, `createRovingFocus`, `createVirtualFocus`, `groupOrientation`, `createDelayed`
- **Headless Radio**: `RadioGroupPrimitive`, `RadioItemPrimitive` (unstyled `role="radioGroup"` / `role="radioButton"` with roving tabindex, arbitrary children, and zero built-in styles)
- **Headless Slider**: `SliderPrimitive` (unstyled horizontal `role="slider"` `<control>` with pointer capture, single-pointer isolation, keyboard `Arrow`/`Page`/`Home`/`End`, independent `pointerStep` vs `step`, `onDraggingChange`, AccessKit `Change` write-back, and `{ value, fraction, dragging, trackRef }` function or static children with zero built-in styles)
- **Headless Menu**: `MenuRootPrimitive`, `MenuListPrimitive`, `MenuItemPrimitive`, `MenuCheckboxItemPrimitive`, `MenuRadioGroupPrimitive`, `MenuRadioItemPrimitive`, `MenuSubPrimitive`, `MenuSubTriggerPrimitive`, `MenuSubContentPrimitive`, `headingToward` (expose `data-state`, `data-highlighted`, `data-disabled` styling hooks; automatically wire `ariaControls`/`ariaPopupFor`/dismiss `exclude` and DPI-aware `headingToward` hover corridors within one native document while omitting foreign node links and using the 180 ms leave grace timer across distinct `PopupSurface` documents)

## Router (`@hewel/zgui/router`)

- `createRouter`, `bindControlNavigation`, `RouterProvider`, `Outlet`, `Link`, `useRouter`, `useLocation`, `useNavigate`, `useParams`, `useSearchParams`, `useMatch`, `useBeforeLeave`, `buildPath`, `joinPaths`, `matchPattern`, `normalizePath`, `parseSearch`, `serializeSearch`

## Host Services (`@hewel/zgui-services`)

Never invoke host services at module top level; call them inside component mount, effects, or event handlers, and release handles on cleanup.

- **Capabilities & Assets**: `getResolvedCapabilities`, `getAuthorizedEndpoint`, `readTextAsset`, `loadTextAsset`, `registerImageAsset`, `loadImageAsset`, `registerImageBytes`, `loadImageBytes`
- **IPC & Processes**: `connectUnixSocket`, `spawnCommand`, `onControlMessage`
- **Clipboard**: `readClipboardText`, `clipboardReadText`, `writeClipboardText`, `readClipboardImage`, `clipboardReadImage`, `writeClipboardImage`
- **Files & Bookmarks**: `openFileDialog`, `saveFileDialog`, `openDirectoryDialog`, `openAuthorizedDirectory`, `persistHandle`, `restoreBookmark`, `listBookmarks`, `revokeBookmark`, `watchDirectory`
- **SQLite & KV**: `openDatabase`, `openKvStore`, `createKvState` (owner-scoped single-key `{ v, data }` persistence over a borrowed `KvStateStorage` with `validate`, serialized coalescing writeback, and async durability `KvState.flush()` — distinct from Solid's synchronous render `flush()`)
- **Reactive Host Reads**: `createHostQuery` (owner-scoped latest-wins `HostRequest<T>` adapter with generation cancellation and `keepPreviousData`)
- **Network (Origin-Allowlisted)**: `httpRequest`, `openEventStream`, `connectWebSocket`, `createScopedFetch`
- **Workers**: `spawnWorker`

## Preview & Verification

- `bun run check` — Runs `fmt:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test:build`, `test:rust`, and `test:vendor` (matching `package.json`).
- `bun run test:vendor [crate]` — Runs Rust tests for excluded `vendor/*` crates (optionally scoped to one crate).
- `bun run test:preview` — Runs headless Vulkan/Stylo visual & behavioral tests (`tests/preview/*.test.mjs`).
- Key docs: `AGENTS.md`, `CODING_STANDARDS.md`, `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/development/crate-map.md`, `docs/development/component-map.md`, `docs/development/preview-verification.md`, `docs/adr/`.
